shortDescription: Avi API Module for pulse registration

options.name: account_id
options.description: account id to be specified for registration.

options.name: api_context
options.description: Avi API context that includes current session ID and CSRF Token. This allows user to perform single login and re-use the session.

options.name: api_version
options.description: Avi API version of to use for Avi API and objects.

options.name: avi_credentials
options.description: Avi Credentials dictionary which can be used in lieu of enumerating Avi Controller login details.

options.name: avi_deactivate_session_cache_as_fact
options.displayName: Avi Deactivate Session Cache As Fact
options.description: It disables avi session information to be cached as a fact.

options.name: case_config
options.description: Dictionary which is used to set the default values to be used for pulse case management.

options.name: controller
options.description: IP address or hostname of the controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_CONTROLLER).

options.name: description
options.description: description to be specified for registration.

options.name: email
options.description: email to be specified for registration.

options.name: enable_appsignature_sync
options.description: Enable to receive application specific signature updates.

options.name: enable_cleanup_of_attached_files
options.description: Enable to clean up the attached files.

options.name: enable_ip_reputation
options.description: Enable to receive IP reputation updates.

options.name: enable_pulse_case_management
options.description: Enable for pulse case management.

options.name: enable_pulse_waf_management
options.description: Enable to receive WAF CRS updates.

options.name: enable_user_agent_db_sync
options.description: Enable to receive bot management updates.

options.name: jwt_token
options.description: Token which is used to login to pulse from controller for the specific user. For generation of the jwt_token paste the related link in Incognito window to prevent IdP from considering any existing valid login session If controller is running >= 21.1.3 and is in ENTERPRISE tier then visit URL :https://portal.pulse.broadcom.com/portal/controller/auth/ctrllogin If controller is running >= 21.1.3 and is in SAAS tier then visit URL :https://portal.pulse.broadcom.com/portal/controller/auth/ccctrllogin

options.name: name
options.description: name to be specified for registration.

options.name: optins
options.description: The opt-in that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: params
options.description: Query parameters passed to the HTTP API.

options.name: password
options.description: Password of Avi user in Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_PASSWORD).

options.name: state
options.description: The state that should be applied on the entity.

options.name: tenant
options.description: Name of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: tenant_uuid
options.description: UUID of tenant used for all Avi API calls and context of object.

options.name: use_tls
options.description: Enable to allow secure end to end communication between controller and NSX alb services.

options.name: username
options.description: Username used for accessing Avi controller. The default value is the environment variable C(AVI_USERNAME).

options.name: waf_config
options.description: Dictionary which is used to set the default values to be used for WAF management.
